patches.name: no-ad-sdk
patches.description: GoogleMobileAdsScript.InitADX(OnComplete) returns immediately: the ADX ad SDK (and its GDPR consent form) is never initialized. The only caller, SystemControl.Open, passes a null callback.

patches.name: grant-all-permissions
patches.description: NetworkControl.CheckPermission(permission, callback) invokes the callback right away (if not null): the game never asks for phone/storage/media permissions. Its only callers are NetworkControl.CheckServerStatus and its own retry lambda. Unity 2020's delegate layout differs from 2022's, so this calls System.Action.Invoke instead of reading the delegate's fields.
patches.asm: cbz x1, 0xC086C0; mov x0, x1; mov x1, xzr; b System.Action$$Invoke (0x1DEBE44); ret

patches.name: no-tapjoy
patches.description: TrackingControl.Open returns at once: it only connects the Tapjoy offerwall SDK (Tapjoy.Connect with the game's SDK key) and registers its callbacks. Offline there are no offerwalls, and the SDK would contact Tapjoy's servers.

patches.name: no-tapjoy-autoconnect
patches.description: TapjoyComponent.ConnectInternal returns false (not connected) without calling the native SDK, so the component's own connect on Start doesn't reach Tapjoy's servers either.

patches.name: no-facebook
patches.description: FacebookControl.Init returns at once (called from its Start and Open): no FB.Init and FB.ActivateApp, so the Facebook SDK doesn't contact Facebook's Graph API (offline there's no Facebook sign-in). The SDK's own auto-init (FacebookInitProvider) already fails without the manifest's settings it needs.

patches.name: account-always-exists
patches.description: LoginControl.get_AccountCode: PlayerPrefs.GetString("vjckkjd", "") gets the key itself as default instead of "". A fresh install therefore has a non-empty account code and the title screen goes straight to auto-login (no guest/nickname popups). The server accepts any credentials.

patches.name: login-always-available
patches.description: LoginControl.get_IsLoginAvailable (stored auth object ID "gsdkln23r8yu9" != 0) returns true. TitleScene.SetStateNetworkStatusCheck then goes straight to SetStateIntro (skipping the language selection) and the title treats the account as usable on a fresh install.

patches.name: skip-terms
patches.description: TitleScene.SetStateTermsAndPolicy() branches to SetStateTutorial(), which is what it does when terms were already accepted (NetworkControl.IsTermsAndPolicy): no terms/privacy screen. The rest of its body is dead and holds default-language-helper.

patches.name: default-language-helper
patches.description: Helper for default-language-from-device (in the dead body of TitleScene.SetStateTermsAndPolicy, skipped by skip-terms): returns LanguageConvert.ConvertLanguage(Application.systemLanguage), the same call TitleScene.SetStateSelectLanguage makes.
patches.asm: stp x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!; mov x0, xzr; bl Application.get_systemLanguage (0x1DB1E34); mov x1, xzr; bl LanguageConvert.ConvertLanguage (0x10617D0); ldp x29, x30, [sp], #16; ret

patches.name: default-language-from-device
patches.description: LocaleControl.get_LanguageCode: PlayerPrefs 'language' defaults to the device language instead of the build language. The original game set it from the device in TitleScene.SetStateSelectLanguage, which is skipped once login-always-available is on; a language chosen in the settings is still kept.

patches.name: skip-download-confirm
patches.description: AssetControl.OnDownloadConfirm: instead of ViewControl.OpenLocalePopup(53, message, callback), invoke the callback (Action<bool> in x20) with isOk=true, so the 'N MB of resources will be downloaded' confirmation never shows and the download starts right away. The function then returns normally.
patches.asm: mov x0, x20; mov w1, #1; mov x2, xzr; bl System.Action<bool>$$Invoke (0x18DA934); nop

patches.name: skip-extra-download-confirm
patches.description: AssetDownloader.ShowDownloadPopup (async; called by AssetControl.StartResourceDownload): instead of ViewControl.OpenLocalePopup(53, message, callback), invoke the callback (<ShowDownloadPopup>b__0 in x21) with isOk=true. That sets the result and clears the wait flag, so the following TaskUtil.WaitUntil returns at once with true. Second path of the same confirmation as skip-download-confirm.
patches.asm: mov x0, x21; mov w1, #1; mov x2, xzr; bl System.Action<bool>$$Invoke (0x18DA934); nop

patches.name: no-login-queue
patches.description: TitleScene.RequestSequentialLogin(callback) invokes the callback right away: no login queue check at sslo-login.dalcomsoft.net (the host is gone; the game would wait forever). Only caller: TitleScene.SetStateLoadingDone.
patches.asm: cbz x1, 0xB23640; mov x0, x1; mov x1, xzr; b System.Action$$Invoke (0x1DEBE44); ret

patches.name: title-skip-login-select
patches.description: TitleScene.SetStateSelectLogin(this, toggleIndex) branches straight to SetStateGuestLogin(this), so the login-method popup (guest/membership/Google/Facebook/Apple/Dalcom) never shows. Fallback; with account-always-exists and login-always-available it isn't reached.

patches.name: no-artist-pack-download-at-login
patches.description: LoginControl.LoginStep23 callback: if the equipped artist pack isn't fully in the download cache (ArtistPackDataControl.Data.IsInstalledAll), the original downloads it during the loading screen (AssetControl.DownloadArtistPack), which waits for a confirmation that can't be shown there (hang after Store.getMyArtistPack in SSOMG). Always continue with LoginStep24 instead.

patches.name: skip-tutorial-proceed-dialog
patches.description: TutorialAssist.OpenAccountConfirmPopup: the end-of-tutorial dialog 'Do you wish to proceed? (Reset Nickname & Cards / Proceed)' is skipped by calling its callback <OpenAccountConfirmPopup>b__9_0(this, isOk: true) directly, i.e. Proceed (sets LoginControl's flag at 0x58 and completes the tutorial step). The reset path re-logs in and hangs with our server (SSOMG).

patches.name: lobby-skip-ad-info
patches.description: LobbyScene.<SetStateAdInfo>b__21_0 (reply to Promotion.getAdminInfo via ADControl.GetAdminInfo): always take the path the game uses when the request failed and go on with SetStateTakeHeadphone. The success path calls ADControl.IsEnabled and sceneView.Hide() (vtable slot 7 of LobbyView), which is what left SSGF's lobby empty.

patches.name: skip-attendance-popup
patches.description: AttendanceAssist.OpenAttendancePopup(this, isChanged) branches to AttendanceAssist.Complete(this, isChanged): the daily attendance popup is skipped (its table ends long before today, in SSOMG it crashed) and the lobby flow continues.

patches.name: no-dalcom-account-event
patches.description: LobbyScene.SetDalcomAccountEvent() branches to SetStateUpdateNotice(), its next step: the Dalcom account promo popup in the lobby never shows.

patches.name: skip-song-download-confirm
patches.description: InstallMusicAssist.OpenDownloadConfirmPopup(this, md, fileSize) branches to OpenInstallMusicPopup(this, md), what its Download button (<>c__DisplayClass9_0.<OpenDownloadConfirmPopup>b__1) does: songs that aren't cached yet download without asking. The rest of its body is left to the UI patches.

patches.name: no-login-queue-leave
patches.description: LoginControl.SequentialLoginCancel() (called by SystemControl.AppSuspend) returns immediately instead of telling sslo-login.dalcomsoft.net that we left the queue.

patches.name: no-restart-after-background
patches.description: SystemControl.CheckRestart() returns false: resuming the app after a long time in the background no longer restarts the game at the title screen (only caller: SystemControl.AppResume). Offline there is no session to refresh.

patches.name: hide-parent-helper
patches.description: Helpers for the menu, settings and store patches, in the dead body of InstallMusicAssist.OpenDownloadConfirmPopup(md, fileSize) after its first instruction (skip-song-download-confirm branches away at the entry). At 0xF1908C: x0 = a component, deactivates its parent GameObject. At 0xF190D0: same for the grandparent (the label's parent is a 'Base' child of the button). Null-safe; preserves x19-x28. Used by hide-menu-attendance, hide-menu-notice, hide-settings-dalcom-id (parent) and hide-popup-shop-button (grandparent).
patches.asm: 0xF1908C hide_parent: stp x30, x19, [sp, #-16]!; cbz x0, ret; bl Component.get_transform; common: cbz x0, ret; bl Transform.get_parent; cbz x0, ret; bl Component.get_gameObject; cbz x0, ret; mov w1, wzr; mov x2, xzr; ldp; b GameObject.SetActive; ret: ldp; ret | 0xF190D0 hide_grandparent: stp; cbz x0, ret; bl Component.get_transform; cbz x0, ret; bl Transform.get_parent; b common

patches.name: hide-left-menu
patches.description: LobbyView.InitMenus: always take the 'left menu closed' branch (the left menu with Event, Special Event, Mission, playtime and attendance starts slid out of view), and fetch leftArrowOff.parent.gameObject (LeftMenu/Bg, the frame of both arrow buttons) instead of leftArrowOff.gameObject, so hide-left-menu-arrow hides the whole button. Everything in that menu is empty offline.
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x19, #168]; mov x1, xzr; bl Transform.get_parent (0x180E87C); mov x1, xzr; bl Component.get_gameObject (0x1DB6AD4); b 0xCEF698 (was: ...; cbz x0; tbz w21, #0, 0xCEF698)

patches.name: hide-left-menu-arrow
patches.description: Second half of hide-left-menu: in the 'closed' branch of LobbyView.InitMenus, SetActive(false) instead of true for the left arrow button (its frame LeftMenu/Bg, see hide-left-menu).
patches.asm: mov w1, wzr (was: orr w1, wzr, #0x1)

patches.name: hide-menu-attendance
patches.description: TopView.SetMoreButton: instead of setting the Attendance label (attendanceText, TopView/Option/BtnMore/Opened/Grid/Attendance/Text), hide its parent, the Attendance button in the ☰ menu (attendance is skipped offline).
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x21, #384]; bl hide-parent-helper (0xF1908C); nop x5

patches.name: hide-menu-notice
patches.description: TopView.SetMoreButton: instead of setting the Notice label (noticeText, .../Grid/UpdateNotice/Text), hide its parent, the News/Notice button in the ☰ menu (there is no news offline).
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x21, #392]; bl hide-parent-helper (0xF1908C); nop x5

patches.name: hide-message-button
patches.description: TopView.RefreshMessageButton(isShow): always hide the Message button in the top bar. The post box has no content offline.
patches.asm: mov w1, wzr (was: and w1, w1, #1)

patches.name: hide-message-button-1
patches.description: TopViewControl.UpdateScene: the inlined copy of RefreshMessageButton for one scene type shows the Message button; hide it instead. The post box has no content offline.
patches.asm: mov w1, wzr (was: orr w1, wzr, #1)

patches.name: hide-message-button-2
patches.description: TopViewControl.UpdateScene: the inlined copy of RefreshMessageButton for one scene type shows the Message button; hide it instead. The post box has no content offline.
patches.asm: mov w1, wzr (was: orr w1, wzr, #1)

patches.name: hide-message-button-3
patches.description: TopViewControl.UpdateScene: the inlined copy of RefreshMessageButton for one scene type shows the Message button; hide it instead. The post box has no content offline.
patches.asm: mov w1, wzr (was: orr w1, wzr, #1)

patches.name: hide-settings-account
patches.description: InfoAccountView.Refresh (the account box in Settings, LayoutAccount: guest info, sign in, sign up, delete account; the regular Dalcom/Google/Facebook/Apple variants) deactivates its own GameObject instead of filling it in. Only caller: SettingPopup.OnRefresh. There are no accounts offline; the buttons were already no-ops (settings-noop-*).
patches.asm: stp x30, x19, [sp, #-16]!; bl Component.get_gameObject; ldp; cbz x0 -> ret; mov w1, wzr; mov x2, xzr; b GameObject.SetActive (tail call); ret

patches.name: hide-settings-dalcom-id
patches.description: SettingPopup.OnBuild: instead of setting the Dalcom ID header (joinDalcomAccountHeader = .../-LayoutFunctions/DalcomAccount/Desc1), hide its parent DalcomAccount, the whole Dalcom account block at the top of Settings (its title accountTitle = DalcomAccount/Title/Text, Desc1 and Desc2). In LOONA this block is the account section's header, so this also covers SSOMG's hide-settings-account-title.
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x19, #280]; bl hide-parent-helper (0xF1908C); nop x7 (was: params null check; joinDalcomAccountHeader.set_text(params[128]))

patches.name: store-missing-tab-no-crash
patches.description: StoreAssist.Start(type, code=-1): the tab for a store type is looked up with StoreMenuControl.MapStoreType (Dictionary<short,short>).get_Item, which throws KeyNotFoundException when no tab of that type exists (diamonds, headphones, home, ... after the StoreMenuData override). Call TryGetValue(type, out display.code) instead (same class, so get_Item's MethodInfo works as the method argument); a missing type leaves code 0, which StorePopup.SetState(short) then resolves through its fallback (store-fallback-card-packs-by-code).
patches.asm: ldr x3, [x8]; add x2, x19, #36; bl Dictionary<short,short>.TryGetValue (0x22C75B4) (was: ldr x2, [x8]; bl get_Item; strh w0, [x19, #36])

patches.name: store-fallback-card-packs-by-code
patches.description: StorePopup.SetState(short code): when no tab with that code exists, it falls back to the first tab of store type 0 (NewBanner, the store home), which the StoreMenuData override removes. Fall back to type 3 (CardPack) instead.

patches.name: store-fallback-card-packs-by-type
patches.description: StorePopup.SetState(StorePopup.TYPE type): when no tab of that type exists, it falls back to type 0 (NewBanner, the store home, removed). Fall back to type 3 (CardPack) instead.

patches.name: hide-popup-shop-button
patches.description: StorePopup.OnBuild: instead of setting the Pop-up Shop button's label (popupStoreText = Popup_Store/Area/Contents/BtnPopupStore/Base/popupStoreText), hide its grandparent BtnPopupStore, the whole button including its TouchArea. The pop-up shop only had real-money offers (PopupStoreData emptied, tab 10000 removed).
patches.asm: ldr x0, [x19, #632]; bl hide_grandparent (0xF190D0); nop x7 (was: params null check; popupStoreText.set_text(params.popupStoreText))

patches.name: store-no-ad-button-refresh
patches.description: StoreAssist.RefreshAdButton returns at once. It reads the ad data (ADControl.GetData), which is empty with the ad SDK off (no-ad-sdk), and threw a NullReferenceException in the store popup's loaded callback, so the store stayed locked to input. There are no ads offline.

patches.name: avpro-use-mediaplayer
patches.description: MediaPlayer.CreatePlatformMediaPlayer creates AVPro Video's Android player with VideoApi.MediaPlayer (1), Android's own player, instead of each player's setting (ExoPlayer, the bundled 2.8.4 from 2018). With ExoPlayer, LOONA crashed on a newer phone (Android 17, Adreno 750) during the first download: in the GPU driver right after the title video started, or with heap corruption (Scudo) on a binder thread. With AVPro switched off completely it ran through, and with MediaPlayer everything works, videos included.
